proofReview.highway: Threshold pivot lies on some original hop-shortest path. Its two endpoints give disjoint strict-distance Voronoi sets closed under rooted shortest paths. A path is unique, so suffix-parent-edge response tests identify the maximum vertex order on that path, including a root endpoint. All replies use one fixed hidden pair.
